name: live-glm-to-qwen-heldout-v1
label: PREREGISTERED before any transfer number was computed
writer: GLM-5.3-Flash on the Sparks (vLLM, fp8_ds_mla cache, latents exported by the owner's handoff connector)
reader: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next MLX 4-bit on the Studio (oMLX runtime, cache seam)
translators: ridge, pool.v1 width 512, 11 levels, fitted on the 156 train chunks only (local/live/translators)
data: the 24 held-out chunks of local/live/corpus.json (sha256 in the run report); never used in fitting

protocol.prefix: all Qwen tokens before the tail; GLM rows are the aligned rows whose Qwen row is inside the prefix
protocol.metric: mean log-probability Qwen assigns to its own true tail tokens (first tail token excluded: it has no in-tail predecessor)

conditions.native: Qwen prefills its own prefix (full state)
conditions.self_kv: Qwen's own canonical KV prefix injected, recurrent state fresh, zero selector keys (connector-mode ceiling)
conditions.telepathy: GLM latents -> GLM writer -> pool.v1 -> Qwen reader -> injected as KV prefix, recurrent state fresh, zero selector keys
conditions.wrong: same as telepathy but with the NEXT held-out chunk's GLM entries (cyclic), truncated to the same length when longer

pass_criteria.C1_content_specific: telepathy > wrong in at least 17 of 24 chunks (one-sided sign test, p = 0.032)
pass_criteria.C2_useful: mean(telepathy) > mean(floor) and telepathy > floor in at least 17 of 24 chunks
pass_criteria.verdict: PASSED only if C1 and C2 both hold; C1 alone = PARTIAL (content crosses but does not help); otherwise FAILED

reported_regardless: fraction of the floor->self_kv gap closed by telepathy
known_limits: KV-only self-transfer closed only 22-30% of the floor->native gap in the exploratory Studio run, so the achievable effect is small
ridge translators are linear and were fitted on ~19k rows of project-document text; held-out relative RMSE 0.69-0.86
